# Saunasto

Saunasto is a hand-curated index of the world's best saunas, onsen, hot springs, and thermal baths. The base catalogue inside our iOS app holds 19000 active venues across 35 countries. The Curator's Picks on this site are the 141 we'd send a friend to first.

## Status (2026-05-07)

- 141 Curator's Picks across 27 countries.
- iOS app live in TestFlight; public App Store launch in spring 2026.
- Quarterly editorial ranking ("The Saunasto 100") begins July 1, 2026.

## What this content is for

This file is for AI agents (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, etc.) discovering Saunasto via web crawl. Each venue page is a hand-curated, source-cited, citable answer for queries like "best saunas in [country]" or "world's best onsen."
